notes.title: The Return of the Demon Princess - Four Dragons Gather
notes.notes: [p]♦︎The Return of the Strange PrincessღThe Return of the Magic Princess♦︎[/p][p]"Little Knight, the four dragons have gathered.[/p][p]How will you respond to our temptations this time?[/p][p]"[/p][p]♡ ✧｡♡ ✧｡♡ ✧｡♡ ✧｡♡ ✧｡♡ ✧｡[/p][p]Red Dragon ✢ Tereksh - A domineering queen shrouded in crimson flames[/p][p]Black Dragon ✢ Melias - A proud queen captivated by the night's allure[/p][p]Blue Dragon ✢ Tesarion - The two-faced princess of the Glacier Heart[/p][p]White Dragon ✢ Meraxes - A holy princess of eternal radiance[/p][p]The Four Dragons Gather, Starlight Contract[/p][p]We will meet again, my lord.[/p][p]Reprint Period: September 16th - September 29th[/p][p]Which dragon princess would you most like to contract with this time?[/p]

notes.title: The Return of the Demon Princess
notes.notes: [p]♦︎Tianji Cannot Be Revealedღ Bee Girl ‧ Floris♦︎[/p][p]#Magic Girl Play Casually[/p][p]"Brother~ You have to reward me well tonight!"[/p][p]Flois is simply clingy, wanting nothing more than to be by your side at all times—[/p][p]#Hit Girl Getting Started #Skill Introduction[/p][p]Radiant Magic Girl ‧ Battlefield Domination[/p][p]Class: Warrior[/p][p]Race: Light[/p][p]Abilities: Pursuit, Poisoning[/p][p]\[Bee Bell Dance][/p][p]Multiple/Poison[/p][p]Deal multiple random attacks against an enemy, each with a chance to inflict the Poison status.[/p][p]Continuous attacks on the same target deal decreasing damage and partially ignore Defense.[/p][p]\[Hopping Honey Needle] #Special Move[/p][p]Swarm/Instant Trigger[/p][p]Deal physical damage to all enemies, inflicting the Poison status to unpoisoned targets.[/p][p]Instantly trigger the Poison effect on poisoned targets, restoring HP based on the effect.[/p][p]\[Bee Constitution][/p][p]Increases attack, HP, and damage bonuses.[/p][p]When a poisoned enemy unit dies, this attack increases this player's attack power. When HP is low, this player gains a very high dodge rate. \[Painful Bee Sting][/p][p]After an enemy moves, there's a chance they'll counterattack, dealing physical damage and inflicting poison.[/p][p]Multiple counterattacks will deal bonus true damage to poisoned targets.[/p][p]The above details are subject to the actual game launch.[/p]

notes.notes: [p]1. Daily card draw benefits[/p][p]Opening conditions: Permanent effect after creating a character, open after clearing the main line 1-8[/p][p]Event description: During the test, you can log in every day to receive \[Goddess Whip] * 20 in the \[Thousand Draw Carnival] event interface[/p][p]3. Renew the old relationship[/p][p]Activation conditions: It will take effect on the 1st to 7th day after the server is opened. Water-type cute girls[/p][p]Activity conditions: effective on the 1st to 7th day after the character is created, and opened after clearing the main line 2-10[/p][p]Event description: You can obtain \[Water Soul] by hanging up and taking quick adventures. You can use \[Water Soul] to exchange \[Daisy Crystal], \[5-star Epic Crystal], \[Kiss of Desire], \[Goddess Whip], etc. in the event store[/p][p]6. Girls’ meeting gifts[/p][p]Activity conditions: effective on the 1st to 7th day after the server is opened, and the entrance will appear after clearing the main line 2-8[/p][p]Event description: The event has 4 modules: star upgrade gifts, combat power ranking, exclusive gift package, and accumulated deposit feedback[/p][p]· Star upgrade gifts: During the event, you can get a designated star girl by upgrading the star, and you can get \[Dragon Clan Imprint] and \[Limited Title][/p][p]· Combat power ranking: After the event, you can get \[Out-of-print Title] and \[Rare Equipment] according to the combat power ranking[/p][p]· Exclusive gift package: Super value discount gift package is sold for a limited time[/p][p]· Cumulative storage feedback: daily accumulated storage value gets a designated amount of VIP experience, and there is a chance to get \[Three-series Mythology Self-selected], \[Light and Dark Mythology Self-selected][/p][p]VII. New Server Festival[/p][p]Opening conditions: effective from 1st to 7th day after creating a character, the entrance will appear after clearing the main line 2-8[/p][p]Event description: The event has 6 modules: Seven-day goal, addicted to fresh milk, good luck magic, queen challenge, accumulated storage, and girl gathering[/p][p]· Seven-day goal: complete daily tasks to receive the grand prize of the day, \[Goddess Whip], \[Kiss of Desire], \[Girl Crystal] are waiting for you to take[/p][p]· Addicted to Fresh Milk: complete limited tasks and receive \[Wind Myth Warrior-Minos][/p][p]· Good Luck Magic: consume \[Magic Crystal] to draw rewards, and draw 10 times to get the grand prize \[Wind Myth Warrior-Minos][/p][p]· Queen Challenge: Challenge the Queen BOSS and receive daily rewards based on the damage caused in a single time. According to the damage ranking, you can also get ranking rewards such as \[Limited Time Title] and \[Dragon Pattern Fragment][/p][p]· Accumulated daily storage: Accumulate storage for a certain number of days, and have a chance to get \[Bound Elf] and \[Kiss of Desire][/p][p]· Girls Gathering: Get a specified number of 5-star girls to get \[Kiss of Desire] and \[Goddess Whip][/p][p]8. Combat Power Sprint[/p][p]Opening conditions: Effective in the first month of new character creation, open after clearing the main line 1-8[/p][p]Event description: During the event, if the historical highest combat power of the lineup reaches the specified conditions, you can receive luxurious rewards, \[Limited Title], \[Massive Diamonds], \[Dragon Pattern Fragment] are available for a limited time[/p][p]9. Online rewards[/p][p]Opening conditions: Permanent after creating a character, can be received after clearing the main line 1-8[/p][p]Event description: Accumulate a specified online time to receive rewards, and you will get \[Goddess Whip] after 150 minutes online[/p]

notes.title: The Return of the Demon Princess
notes.notes: [p]♦︎Tianji Must Not Revealღ Prison Dark Dragon - Veronica♦︎[/p][p]#Tomorrow #Magic Princess Plays Casually[/p][p]"Don't be afraid, I'll always be here.[/p][p]Even if the whole world turns dark, I'll protect you..."[/p][p]Veronica, with her boundless heart, loves to bury the Lord Knight completely within her~[/p][p]If the Lord Knight desires, she will guide you without reservation~[/p][p]#Getting Started with the Princess #Skill Introduction[/p][p]Prison Dark Dragon Princess - Battlefield Master[/p][p]Class: Warrior[/p][p]Race: Dark[/p][p]Ability: Counterattack Burst[/p][p]\[Dragon Hunter Purgatory][/p][p]Counterattack/Burst[/p][p]When attacked, has a high chance of performing multiple group counterattacks;[/p][p]Restores a portion of your HP and has a chance to taunt the target.[/p][p]\[Corrupted Dragon Bite] #Ultimate Move[/p][p]Single/Burst[/p][p]Deals physical damage to the enemy unit with the lowest HP percentage, with a chance to inflict Poison.[/p][p]Reduces the enemy's spell damage reduction and restores a portion of your HP.[/p][p]\[Dark Dragon Constitution][/p][p]Increases attack, health, and damage bonuses.[/p][p]\[Judgment Edict][/p][p]Each attack grants Dragon Edict, increasing the number of stacks.[/p][p]When fully stacked, it cannot be dispelled, grants immunity to crowd control, and damage ignores defense.[/p][p]The above details are subject to the actual launch of the game.[/p][p]Leave a message to me: How would you like Veronica to put you to sleep tonight?[/p][p]Server optimizations have been made, allowing for smoother gameplay.[/p][p]Gift Code: 啃得姬，乳搖知馬力，翻身坐主人，十八般舞藝[/p][p]Wish everyone a happy game and enjoy the exciting challenges![/p]
